title: citry-events/1 component class descriptor
description: One strict component-class record from a data-citry-events manifest.

componentClassId.description: The server-assigned ID used by calls targeting this component class.

eventHandlers.description: Maps each public handler name to the browser hints for that handler.

writableStateFields.description: Public State fields the browser may update. Omitted when every public field is writable; an empty array allows none.

httpMethod.description: The uppercase HTTP method used for the handler's route.

usesState.description: Present only when the handler receives State.

latestCallWins.description: Present only when a newer queued call supersedes older calls to this handler.

allowBatching.description: Present only when the handler must be sent alone.
